results.title: An API key used on an endpoint that takes no permission
results.evidence: a key scoped to `model:read` alone read 4 route(s) that take no permission — ['/api/v1/document-kinds', '/api/v1/document-subjects', '/api/v1/model-relations', '/api/v1/export-packs']. The scope check is inside `Routes.authorise`, and about 78 call sites use `self.principal(request)` instead (against 494 that authorise), so none of those consults `api_key_scopes`.
